title: Lotus pose resin figurine
text: Lotus pose resin figurine. This figurine is really lovely.  Graceful, peaceful.  It is about 8" tall.  It is resin, but a nice weight.  She sits very nicely and level on my counter (smooth, flat surface).  It is white, but a soft white - not a bright white.  I am very, very happy with my purchase.  Having said that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Seraphic 8" Yoga Mountain Pose Sculpture/Statue
features: This sculpture depicts the sitting yoga mountain pose.
Makes a great gift for any yoga lover.
